description: Extract structured JSON from a web page (AI). Fetch a public web page and extract the fields you name into clean JSON (e.g. fields=name,price,currency,availability or company,ceo,founded). Missing values come back as null. Up to 20 fields. Example output: {"url":"https://example.com","data":{"title":"Example Domain","contact_email":null,"description":"…"}}. Price: $0.016 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: ai_extract
